title: Extreme values of a nonconstant monotone function
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be monotone and nonconstant. Then $f((-1,\ldots,-1))=-1$ and $f((1,\ldots,1))=1$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to the two signs
